IBM is a technology and consulting company seeking an Application Developer in Bellevue, Washington. The role focuses on designing and executing performance and non-functional tests, monitoring application and server performance, tracking defects, documenting results, and collaborating with development, DevOps, and architecture teams to support release readiness and system scalability.

Responsibilities
Develop detailed non-functional test plans using JMeter and LoadRunner, outlining load, scalability, and endurance testing scenarios based on technical requirements
Design and document performance test cases and scripts per release using JMeter and custom scripting to validate application throughput, latency, and stability across various environments
Execute load, stress, scalability, and endurance tests using JMeter and LoadRunner, incorporating SQLbased test data sets to evaluate system behavior under concurrent user activity
Monitor server-side performance using Dynatrace, analyzing CPU utilization, memory consumption, JVM threads, service latency, API call performance, and database interactions to identify bottlenecks during performance cycles
Log and track performance defects per release cycle using Jira and Rally, validate fixes through retesting, and coordinate with development teams to ensure timely resolution
Participate in sprint ceremonies and client review meetings using Agile tools such as Jira and Confluence, providing daily updates on test progress, risks, dependencies, and performance findings
Generate Daily Status Reports (DSR), Weekly Status Reports (WSR), and performance test summaries using Excel, Confluence, and PowerPoint, document key performance indicators including throughput, response times, failure trends, and resource utilization
Create final test closure documentation, including exit criteria validation, unresolved defect logs, environment notes, and performance benchmark summaries using Confluence and SharePoint to support release readiness
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including developers, DevOps, and architects using Git, Jenkins, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure test environment readiness, troubleshoot build issues, and validate system stability
Analyze historical performance trends and propose improvements using Dynatrace dashboards, log analysis tools, and CI/CD metrics, supporting long-term scalability and system optimization
Utilize: JMeter, LoadRunner, Dynatrace, Jira, Rally, Confluence, Git, Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines
